events.title: Otto I issues the Diploma Ottonianum to Pope John XII
events.description: The newly crowned emperor Otto I issued a charter to Pope John XII confirming the papacy's possession of the lands granted by the Carolingians. It also required each newly elected pope to swear loyalty before imperial envoys prior to consecration.
events.html: The newly crowned emperor Otto I issued a charter to Pope John XII confirming the papacy's possession of the lands granted by the Carolingians. It also required each newly elected pope to swear loyalty before imperial envoys prior to consecration.

events.title: Mongols begin the sack of Baghdad
events.description: Hulagu's troops entered Baghdad and began a week of killing and plunder. Libraries and the city's great institutions of learning were destroyed, and tens of thousands of inhabitants died.
events.html: Hulagu's troops entered Baghdad and began a week of killing and plunder. Libraries and the city's great institutions of learning were destroyed, and tens of thousands of inhabitants died.

events.title: The central tower of Ely Cathedral collapses
events.description: In the night, possibly because of digging for the Lady Chapel's foundations, the Norman central crossing tower of Ely Cathedral collapsed. It was replaced by a far larger open octagon, built under Alan of Walsingham, the cathedral's most distinctive feature.
events.html: In the night, possibly because of digging for the Lady Chapel's foundations, the Norman central crossing tower of Ely Cathedral collapsed. It was replaced by a far larger open octagon, built under Alan of Walsingham, the cathedral's most distinctive feature.

events.title: Genoa's fleet wins a night battle in the Bosporus
events.description: Fought largely at night in a storm, the battle between Genoa's fleet and the allied fleets of Venice, Aragon and the Byzantine Empire left Genoa the victor. Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos then made terms with Genoa and left the War of the Straits.
events.html: Fought largely at night in a storm, the battle between Genoa's fleet and the allied fleets of Venice, Aragon and the Byzantine Empire left Genoa the victor. Emperor John VI Kantakouzenos then made terms with Genoa and left the War of the Straits.

events.title: Edward IV signs a secret treaty with the Lord of the Isles
events.description: Edward IV of England agreed with John of Islay, Lord of the Isles, and the exiled Earl of Douglas that a conquered Scotland would be divided between John and Douglas as vassals of England. Its discovery cost John the earldom of Ross.
events.html: Edward IV of England agreed with John of Islay, Lord of the Isles, and the exiled Earl of Douglas that a conquered Scotland would be divided between John and Douglas as vassals of England. Its discovery cost John the earldom of Ross.

events.title: Catherine Howard is executed at the Tower of London
events.description: Henry VIII's fifth wife, still a teenager, was beheaded for adultery and treason. She was the second of his queens to be executed, after her cousin Anne Boleyn.
events.html: Henry VIII's fifth wife, still a teenager, was beheaded for adultery and treason. She was the second of his queens to be executed, after her cousin Anne Boleyn.

events.title: Galileo arrives in Rome to face the Inquisition
events.description: Summoned over his 'Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems', Galileo reached Rome. Tried that spring, he was forced to abjure the view that the Earth moves and spent his last years under house arrest.
events.html: Summoned over his 'Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems', Galileo reached Rome. Tried that spring, he was forced to abjure the view that the Earth moves and spent his last years under house arrest.

events.title: William III and Mary II offered the English crown
events.description: At the Banqueting House, the Convention Parliament presented the Declaration of Rights and offered the throne jointly to William and Mary. The settlement limited royal power and confirmed Parliament's role.
events.html: At the Banqueting House, the Convention Parliament presented the Declaration of Rights and offered the throne jointly to William and Mary. The settlement limited royal power and confirmed Parliament's role.

events.title: Fortress of Gaeta surrenders, ending the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies
events.description: After a three-month siege by Piedmontese forces, King Francis II surrendered Gaeta and went into exile. Weeks later the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed under Victor Emmanuel II.
events.html: After a three-month siege by Piedmontese forces, King Francis II surrendered Gaeta and went into exile. Weeks later the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed under Victor Emmanuel II.

events.title: Allied bombers begin the destruction of Dresden
events.description: British and then American raids over two days created a firestorm that killed about 25,000 people and destroyed the historic centre. The attack's justification has been debated ever since.
events.html: British and then American raids over two days created a firestorm that killed about 25,000 people and destroyed the historic centre. The attack's justification has been debated ever since.

events.title: Kevin Rudd apologises to the Stolen Generations
events.description: Australia's Prime Minister delivered a formal apology in Parliament to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people taken from their families under past government policies.
events.html: Australia's Prime Minister delivered a formal apology in Parliament to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people taken from their families under past government policies.

song: Chilean Nueva Canción (New Chilean Song) movement
A Chilean folk song from 1966 by Violeta Parra that gives thanks for the gifts of life.
